name: Paper God: Daoist Immortal Who Brings Profit and Happiness, with Two Attendants and a Horse
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；early 20th century；Woodblock print; ink on paper; with printed inscription reading from right to left: "Li Shi Ying Xi Xian Guan" ("Daoist Immortal Who Brings Profit and Happiness"). Probably from Beijing.
